title: Eric Wargo: remote viewing as precognition

tellings.quote: Eric Wargo argues this in his book time Loops that remote viewing is really just precognition

plain: Remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe a distant or hidden place using only the mind, may really be precognition, a glimpse of one's own future, according to the writer Eric Wargo. Michels brings this up from Wargo's book Time Loops, where he says Wargo makes that argument.
